plan: Given my private value of $9, I aim to maximize profit by bidding below my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. Assuming other bidders bid close to their values, I will bid $5. Given my private value of $45, my aim is to bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win. I expect others to bid close to their values, possibly around $30-$40. By bidding $40, I maximize my chances of winning while ensuring a profit of $5 if successful. This balances the risk of overbidding with the reward of winning the auction.

Given my private value for the prize is $0, my optimal strategy is to bid $0. Bidding any positive amount would result in a guaranteed loss, as I would pay more than the value I receive. Since my value is $0, I have no incentive to win the auction, and therefore, the best course of action is to bid nothing.
